ShortDescription.Value: Unlock all Signature, place multiple Unique buildings, and customize city-wide and local effects to be vanilla or non-stacking bonuses.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Realistic Signature Buildings
Build as many Signature buildings as you like without stacking their city-wide bonuses. Choose realistic limits or keep vanilla behavior. Buildings can provide global city bonuses that stack. Bonus stacking from unique/signature buildings, monuments, and policies often breaks economic realism by making companies overly profitable and eliminating natural supply-and-demand challenges.
### Realistic Signature Buildings lets you enjoy the buildings without runaway bonuses.
- Build multiple Unique and Signature buildings without stacking the same city-wide benefits. - Control city-wide bonuses and nearby local effects independently. - Choose more realistic limits, disable certain bonuses, or keep vanilla behavior for local area effects, while limiting city0wide bonuses to First instance of the building.
### More building freedom. Less bonus inflation. Your choice.
### All optional: choose how you want to play - Place multiple Unique buildings for their appearance without multiplying the same Signature bonuses. - Optionally unlock all Signature buildings without waiting for progression. - Control city-wide and nearby/local Signature effects **separately**.
For example, if two copies would each add the same city-wide bonus, you can stop that bonus from stacking while keeping both buildings' normal nearby happiness effects.
### Signature bonuses: two independent controls
**City-wide Signature bonuses** (default: First copy only) - **First copy only** — each Signature building type provides its city-wide bonus once, even if you build more copies. - **No city-wide bonuses** — disables Signature city-wide bonuses. - **Vanilla Stacked Bonuses** — every placed copy provides its normal city-wide bonus.
**Nearby Signature effects** (default: Vanilla nearby effects) - **Vanilla nearby effects** — every copy provides its normal local effects. - **First copy only** — one copy of each Signature building type provides local effects. - **No nearby effects** — disables normal local effects from Signature buildings.
These controls work independently. Building attractiveness and abandoned-building effects are not removed.
### More features - **Unlock Signature requirements** — make Signature buildings available without population, zoning, or other progression requirements (default: OFF). - **Hide bulk Signature unlock pop-ups** — shown only when Signature unlocking is enabled. ON by default (recommended) to prevent dozens or hundreds of nuisance pop-ups when loading a city. Turn it OFF to see notices for newly unlocked Signature buildings; regular vanilla notifications are unchanged. - **Allow multiple copies of Unique buildings**, including Signatures (default: ON). Switching this OFF does not bulldoze copies already placed. - **Live Options** — bonus modes change without restarting the city. - **Status and diagnostics** — view Signature building counts, duplicates, and active city-wide bonus providers. **Status report to log** records current city-wide bonuses and nearby effects without changing them. - **Compare bonus modes to log** — temporarily tests all city-wide and nearby modes while the game is paused in Options, then reapplies your selected modes. - Works alongside **Anarchy**. Other mods with the same Multiple Unique feature are redundant.
### Notes - Optional automatic infoview suppression for Unique and Signature placement (default: OFF). No Harmony patching. - Most changes happen when needed; no ongoing city-wide scanning for the bonus dropdowns. - To read diagnostic results: Options > About > Debug / Logging > Open Log. - Hover over Options rows for explanations. - Custom assets may have different bonus types or none at all.
## Support and Feedback - Support by clicking Like (top right), no donations requested, just a like for many days of work. - For feedback, use the GitHub or Discord links on this page. PRs are welcome.
